title: Lost in Phonation: Voice Quality Variation as an Evaluation Dimension for Speech Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Synthesizing speech prompts with controlled variations in phonation (modal, breathy, creaky, and end-creak) and evaluating speech foundation model responses across open-ended generation tasks (using an LLM judge) and speech emotion recognition.

Analyzing the effect of the speaker's binary gender (male vs. female) on model outputs, including LLM judge ratings on dimensions like salary offers and leadership endorsement, as well as shifts in predicted emotion probabilities.
